name: anvaya
description: AI failure observability — detect, classify, and attribute failures in AI products

scripts.build: npm run build -w @anvaya/core && npm run build -w @anvaya/sdk && npm run build -w @anvaya/server && npm run build -w @anvaya/ui
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @anvaya/core && npm run build -w @anvaya/sdk && npm run build -w @anvaya/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @anvaya/server" "npm run dev -w @anvaya/ui"
